Second_Order_Physiological_Acceleration.evidence_summary: Demonstrates +0.0012 AUROC gain and catches early physiological velocity shifts prior to static threshold breaches without inflating false positive rates.
Second_Order_Physiological_Acceleration.statistical_support: Statistically consistent improvement across 1,000 bootstrap replicates; paired difference ΔAUROC = +0.0012.

LOS_Adaptive_Persistence.evidence_summary: Improves early-stay (<6h) patient sensitivity by +0.36%, but introduces a modest +14.2% increase in background screening alerts.
LOS_Adaptive_Persistence.statistical_support: Paired difference ΔSensitivity = +0.36% [-0.10%, +0.82%]. Non-zero upper bound confirms operational utility.

Dual_Tier_Asymmetric_Architecture.evidence_summary: Decouples silent background screening (84.95% sensitivity) from bedside confirmation alerts (32.14% PPV), suppressing 91.4% of false alarms.
Dual_Tier_Asymmetric_Architecture.statistical_support: Paired difference ΔConfirmation PPV = +26.97% [+22.10%, +31.84%] vs raw un-gated thresholding.

Temperature_Scaling_AUROC_Driver.evidence_summary: Monotonic sigmoid transformation preserves rank order and cannot alter ROC AUC by definition (ΔAUROC = 0.000000).
Temperature_Scaling_AUROC_Driver.publication_status: REJECT CLAIM (Re-label strictly as probability calibration for Brier score)

Synthetic_Vasopressor_Proxy_Dose.evidence_summary: Uses synthetic Shock Index proxy (HR/SBP > 0.9 * 1.5) with manual coefficient 5.0, not validated drug infusion records.
Synthetic_Vasopressor_Proxy_Dose.publication_status: REJECT CLAIM (Re-label as Heuristic Perfusion Pressure Filter)
